title: Shared time and a first performance timeline
summary: A luminous abstract performance stage made from hand-cut paper shapes, cobalt blue and orange light, energetic theatrical composition. Shared visuals and sound with editable automation.

steps.title: Open the shared timeline
steps.text: Press Alt+Shift+T or use the timeline node. Play advances project time even while the dock is hidden. Opening a view never starts sound.
steps.hint: Use ▥ on mod.timeline. The floating view uses the same clock.

steps.title: Inspect clock units
steps.text: chop.time selects seconds, quarter notes, meter beats, bars, 480-PPQ ticks or phase. Its JSON is visible in dat.inspect.
steps.hint: Choose beat in the unit menu; 6/8 has six eighth-note meter beats per bar.

steps.title: Use global time in expressions
steps.text: Both visuals use linked project time. The colorful expression reads __.beat and __.time directly. x/y are normalized and c is the output RGB channel.
steps.hint: Try 0.5+0.5*sin(__.time+x*8+c*2). Offsets x/y/z/t can be wired.

steps.title: Play sound deliberately
steps.text: Press Start on mod.output, then Play the project clock. Sequence notes follow score beats; tempo edits retain phase. Panic stops all browser outputs.
steps.hint: Sound is silent until mod.output Start, even if the timeline plays.

steps.title: Record and edit a parameter
steps.text: Select top.noise, choose scale in the timeline parameter menu and press ●. Change its scale parameter, then press ● again. A numeric curve clip appears.
steps.hint: Drag the clip or its ends; Option-drag an edge stretches, double click loops. ◇ adds a key. Keys expand below the ruler.

steps.title: Scrub, reset and export
steps.text: Drag the ruler or playhead. Seeking pauses sound scheduling, updates linked stateless visuals and clears linked feedback. JSON export includes clock, musical context, tracks and clips.
steps.hint: Scrubbing is silent. Arbitrary p5 simulation state is not reconstructed by seeking. Replay from zero for stateful sketches.
